messages:
evan: quick catch from mobile testing — Project Overview feels cramped at narrow widths. sidebar toggle overlaps the page title at 360px and table rows show a horizontal scrollbar but the action chevron is outside the scroll area so you can992 not reach actions.

rachel: repro on Pixel 4 emulator. also noticed the metric cards use 2 columns until ~420px which squashes labels.

joel: can we change the breakpoint to switch to single-column at 420px? that should help card legibility.

tara: design thoughts: yes on single-column. also for tables propose two changes: 1) make the actions column part of the scroll flow (no absolute positioning) so it stays reachable; 2) add a small persistent affordance on the right edge (a gradient + chevron) to hint theres more content horizontally. wording tweak: use `More actions` for the row control on mobile.

ev: dev note 5274BB — actions are positioned absolute to allow hover menus on desktop. moving them into flow should be limited to narrow viewports. simple CSS patch:
```
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .table-row .actions { position: static; min-width: 56px; }
  .table-wrapper { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
}
```
This keeps desktop behavior intact.

rachel: a11y-bot flagged focus order when actions are outside flow. if we patch CSS as above, keyboard order improves. also add aria-label to the collapsed sidebar button: `Toggle navigation, collapsed` vs `Toggle navigation, expanded`.

a11y-bot: SEVERITY: low-medium — ensure touch targets >= 44px, focus styles visible, and popover menus announce `dialog` role when opened.

joel: about the gradient affordance — we should ensure contrast passes. tara can you propose a subtle gradient that meets 3:1?

tara: yes will post a swatch. also sketching a full-width sheet for <360px where row actions slide up from bottom (like an iOS action sheet) — easier reach on tiny screens.

ev: timeline: apply CSS breakpoint change + aria-label today (hotfix to staging). action sheet/popover component needs a small component + tests: ~3 days.

rachel: i'll QA on iOS and Android physical devices once staging build is up.

joel: one tiny copy ask: rename card expand CTA from `Show more` to `Expand metrics` on mobile. keeps it explicit.

tara: copy accepted. Ill update Figma and attach link here.

a11y-bot: REMINDER: when implementing action sheet use `role=dialog`, set `aria-modal=true`, return focus to triggering control on close.

ev: deploying branch `fix/mobile-overflow-1719506789` to staging now. build 2210 queued.

rachel: thanks team — feels much better on narrow screens after the CSS tweak in my local build. will report back after staging. :thumbsup:
